definitions.explanation: A person who owns a house or apartment building and rents it out to tenants.
The person who owns and lives in a house (less common usage).

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}に{家賃|やちん}を{払|はら}う。
examples.english: I pay rent to the landlord.

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}の{許可|きょか}がないと{改装|かいそう}できない。
examples.english: You can't renovate without the landlord's permission.

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}さんがとても{親切|しんせつ}な{人|ひと}で{助|たす}かった。
examples.english: I was grateful that the landlord was a very kind person.

notes:
USAGE: {家主|やぬし} is the standard term for a landlord in rental situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家主|やぬし}に{連絡|れんらく}する (to contact the landlord)
・{家主|やぬし}の{許可|きょか} (the landlord's permission)
・{家主|やぬし}と{借主|かりぬし} (landlord and tenant)

RELATED:
・{大家|おおや} - landlord (more colloquial, often for apartment buildings)
・{地主|じぬし} - landowner
・{借主|かりぬし} - tenant, renter
